Training

How you can train

From the gym’s own photos on Google and from what members write in their reviews.

Semi personal training

A personal training programme based on your own goals, with constant guidance from experienced trainers.

Nutrition and progress

Members write about a nutritionist, dietary recommendations and body measurements to track progress. A diet plan comes up in 11 reviews.

Train on your own

You can also train on your own. Members write that the team is always there to help, guide and correct you when needed.

How members describe it

Taken from what members write in their Google reviews.

Welcoming

Members write that you feel at home from the first day. The welcoming atmosphere comes up 23 times in the reviews.

Knowledgeable

Trainers who explain the exercises well and take the time to explain things properly. Personal trainers come up in 16 reviews.

Clean

Members describe a gym that is always clean, spacious and well organised, with machines in good condition.

What members say

Three of 98 Google reviews, all with five stars.
